title: How Many Kinds of Sensory Neuron?

scenes.tts: One mouse data set sorted sensory neurons into eleven kinds. A larger one, three years later, found seventeen. A twenty twenty four merger of thirty one data sets from six species settled on eighteen. Which number is right? None of the three is wrong, and none is final.

scenes.tts: The dorsal root ganglion, or D R G, holds the cell bodies of sensory neurons. In twenty fifteen, Usoskin and colleagues sequenced the RNA of 622 single neurons from mouse ganglia. An unsupervised method grouped them without being told the answer. Eleven classes came out. Five were neurofilament rich, three were non peptidergic, two were peptidergic, and one was marked by tyrosine hydroxylase.
scenes.caption: The dorsal root ganglion (DRG) holds the cell bodies of sensory neurons. In 2015, Usoskin and colleagues sequenced the RNA of 622 single neurons from mouse ganglia. Five were neurofilament-rich, three were non-peptidergic, two were peptidergic, and one was marked by tyrosine hydroxylase.

scenes.tts: Think of a map. A country level map and a county level map of the same land are both correct. They differ in resolution. Zeisel and colleagues, in twenty eighteen, resolved eight peptidergic, six non peptidergic and three neurofilament types. That makes seventeen. More cells, deeper sequencing or a finer clustering setting can split branches.

scenes.tts: In twenty twenty four, Bhuiyan, Renthal and colleagues merged thirty one data sets from six mammalian species into one reference. It holds eighteen D R G subtypes. The authors stressed that preparation, sequencing depth and analysis change how many subtypes are resolved. One group is defined by injury induced transcription factors. They call it the Atf3 group. That is a warning that an atlas can mix types with states.

scenes.tts: Can a state be told from a type? Renthal and colleagues cut or crushed peripheral nerves in mice, then sequenced single nuclei from the ganglion. Injured neurons lost much of the expression that marked their subtype. Over a time course associated with axons regrowing to their targets, identity re emerged. Timing alone does not prove that regrowth restores identity.

scenes.tts: So what is a type? A molecular group that recurs across data sets. It also needs an independent anchor, such as an ending, a physiology, a target, or behaviour after manipulation. Even then, read it with its state and its resolution in mind. Read each count with its data set, resolution and state.
